description: Controllers and their Bluetooth links: headline counts, one health row per controller, a per-controller drill-down, connection quality, battery, poll health and, collapsed, the Pi-only pairing-daemon and adapter panels. Replaces Controller Overview, Controller Maintenance and Bluetooth Adapter Overview (#1427). The dashboard SPA's Metrics tab embeds it (uid controller-overview).
title: Controllers & Bluetooth

panels.title: Connected
panels.description: Controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1).

Controllers at battery level 0 or 1 of 5 (controller_battery_level < 2), the controller manager's low-battery level; the one threshold every dashboard uses (telemetry.md §6.1). Only connected controllers count (controller_connected == 1): the battery series of a controller that left is never removed.

targets.expr: count((controller_battery_level and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) < 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Low Battery

panels.description: Controllers with RSSI below -80 dBm (poor), the threshold every dashboard uses (telemetry.md §6.1). RSSI comes from the pairing daemon, so this is 0 off the Pi. Only links the pairing daemon reports as connected (bluetooth_device_connected == 1, joined on serial and hci_adapter) of controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1, joined on serial) count: neither RSSI series is removed when a link or controller goes away (#1468).

targets.expr: count((bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) < -80) or vector(0)

panels.title: Weak Signal

panels.description: Controllers with effective poll rate below 50 Hz (degraded connection). Matches controller_poll_degraded spans in Jaeger.

targets.expr: count(((scalar(controller_polling_target_hz) - rate(controller_poll_drops_total[$__rate_interval])) * on(serial) group_left(name) controller_info or on(serial, name) (controller_info * 0 + scalar(controller_polling_target_hz))) < 50) or vector(0)

panels.title: Degraded Poll

panels.description: Controllers whose connection quality is poor (controller_connection_quality == 2, UC-035 BR-005).

targets.expr: max by (serial, hci_adapter) (bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1)

panels.description: RSSI of this controller from the pairing daemon (Pi only). Only links the pairing daemon reports as connected (bluetooth_device_connected == 1, joined on serial and hci_adapter) of controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1, joined on serial) count: neither RSSI series is removed when a link or controller goes away (#1468).

targets.expr: bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm{serial="$controller"} and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1

panels.description: Connection quality per controller (UC-035 BR-005): worse of p95 report gap (<=22 good, <=30 fair, >30 ms poor) and longest gap in 10 s (<=30 good, <=50 fair, >50 ms poor). Gaps are taken at the controller manager's 100 Hz poll pick-up with the poll loop's own lateness subtracted; thresholds not yet validated on Pi hardware.
panels.title: Connection Quality

panels.description: p95 gap between fresh frames per controller over a rolling 10 s window: <=22 ms good, <=30 ms fair, above poor (UC-035 BR-005)
panels.title: p95 Report Gap (10 s)

panels.description: Longest gap between fresh frames per controller over a rolling 10 s window, still-open gap included: <=30 ms good, <=50 ms fair, above poor (UC-035 BR-005)
panels.title: Longest Report Gap (10 s)

panels.description: p95 age of each controller's sample when it is sent on a game's gameplay stream (controller_input_lag_seconds, #1335): from the controller manager's poll pick-up to the gRPC send; excludes the Bluetooth / HID hop. No data outside games.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, serial) (rate(controller_input_lag_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) * on(serial) group_left(name) controller_info

panels.title: Input Lag p95 (per controller)

panels.description: Average signal strength per Bluetooth adapter Only links the pairing daemon reports as connected (bluetooth_device_connected == 1, joined on serial and hci_adapter) of controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1, joined on serial) count: neither RSSI series is removed when a link or controller goes away (#1468).

targets.expr: avg by(hci_adapter) ((bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1))

panels.title: Avg Signal per Adapter

panels.description: RSSI signal strength per controller (Bluetooth only, 0 = USB) Only links the pairing daemon reports as connected (bluetooth_device_connected == 1, joined on serial and hci_adapter) of controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1, joined on serial) count: neither RSSI series is removed when a link or controller goes away (#1468).

targets.expr: (bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) * on(serial) group_left(name) controller_info

panels.title: Signal Strength (RSSI)

panels.description: Signal strength over time grouped by Bluetooth adapter Only links the pairing daemon reports as connected (bluetooth_device_connected == 1, joined on serial and hci_adapter) of controllers the controller manager reports as connected (controller_connected == 1, joined on serial) count: neither RSSI series is removed when a link or controller goes away (#1468).

targets.expr: (bluetooth_device_rssi_dbm and on(serial, hci_adapter) bluetooth_device_connected == 1 and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) * on(serial) group_left(name) controller_info

panels.title: Signal Strength History (by adapter)

panels.description: Effective poll rate aggregated by Bluetooth adapter. Shows average poll rate across controllers on each adapter. Low values indicate adapter-level connection issues.

targets.expr: avg by(adapter) ((scalar(controller_polling_target_hz) - rate(controller_poll_drops_total[$__rate_interval])) * on(serial) group_left(adapter) (controller_adapter_info and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) or on(serial, adapter) ((controller_adapter_info and on(serial) controller_connected == 1) * 0 + scalar(controller_polling_target_hz)))

panels.title: Effective Poll Rate (per adapter)

panels.description: Poll error rate aggregated by Bluetooth adapter (hci device). Any errors indicate connection problems at the adapter level.

targets.expr: sum by(adapter) (rate(controller_poll_errors_total[1m]) * on(serial) group_left(adapter) (controller_adapter_info and on(serial) controller_connected == 1))

panels.title: Poll Error Rate (per adapter)

panels.description: Adapter identity from hciconfig -a and sysfs (UC-035 step 6): identify chipsets by HCI manufacturer (Realtek 93, Cambridge Silicon Radio 10, Broadcom 15, Cypress 305), not by brand. 'unknown' when the adapter is down or sysfs is not readable.
panels.title: Adapter Identity

panels.description: Increases of the kernel's cumulative HCI RX/TX error counters per adapter (UC-035 step 6). Zero errors do not prove there were no retransmissions.
panels.title: HCI Errors (5 min)

panels.description: Links per adapter by the local adapter's role from hcitool con (UC-035 step 6). Roles are observed only; BlueZ negotiates them.
panels.title: Link Roles per Adapter
